data.bio: Alec is a young man who shares his name with his father, continuing a family naming tradition. He has a unique family situation - his aunt Marla used to be married to his uncle Pelon, and he has two cousins named Proctor and Gamble who all live with Maria and her fiance Sal. Alec works as a software developer and enjoys spending time with his extended family. He values the relationships he has with all of his family members, despite the complex family structure.
